name: omaddons
author: a44
description: World of Warcraft addons on every client: updates, Lua errors and WTF backups, from the omaddons CLI.

barWidget.description: One gamepad for every WoW client: a badge for pending addon updates, urgent when something is broken or an addon threw Lua errors, and a keyboard panel to update, undo, back up and restore. Every action is an omaddons command line, recorded and undoable.

schema.label: omaddons binary
schema.description: Empty runs the binary that installed the widget (omaddons omarchy install stamps its path). Set a path to run another build.

schema.label: Panel width
schema.description: How wide the panel opens, from 400 to 800 px; z in the panel fills the screen.

schema.label: Check for updates when due
schema.description: Run omaddons outdated in the background when a client's last check is older than check_interval_hours in omaddons' config.toml.

schema.label: Notify about new updates
schema.description: A notification when a check finds updates that weren't there before.

schema.label: Notify about Lua errors after a session
schema.description: A notification once you quit, if the session left new Lua errors.

schema.label: Notify while a game runs
schema.description: Off keeps notifications quiet while a World of Warcraft client runs (or might), and says what came up in one notification when the last one stops.

schema.label: Fallback refresh (seconds)
schema.description: Safety-net refresh behind the doorbell; 15 s while the panel is open.

schema.label: Show the keybinding tip
schema.description: After the panel is first opened by mouse, a card shows the line that binds a key to it. Seeing it turns this Off.
